source_quote: Dense undercoat cohorts showed higher recurrent dermatitis prevalence.
Double-coated breeds had increased pyotraumatic dermatitis episodes.
Single-coated dogs showed more frequent barrier dysfunction signs.
Single-coat dogs still maintained notable otitis burden.
Curly-coated dogs had significantly higher otitis externa prevalence.
Curly coat phenotypes presented atopic disease above baseline.
Wire coats were associated with moderate interdigital inflammation burden.
Wire-coated dogs showed mild but persistent xerosis prevalence.
Hairless dogs had elevated chronic photo-dermatitis incidence.
Hairless cohorts showed recurrent superficial folliculitis prevalence.
